question: Six people, E, F, G, H, I and P, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of P. Only two people sit between P and E. Only one person sits between E and H. Only I sits between P and G. How many people sit between F and I?
solution:
Given: Six people, E, F, G, H, I and P, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of P. 

2) Only two people sit between P and E.

3) Only one person sits between E and H.

4) Only I sits between P and G.

5) M sits to the immediate right of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cafd3f0fe9f4febe9430ba9597b078929d3eaf7447df39c34814072b55b32fe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce2c6821cf738f037b3a959e2ea273cd68e7f54217d270bac9d27ba97af91bf0.png] 

So, There are 2 people sit between F and I.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
